environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster (v1.28) with namespace-level Pod Security Standards enforcement. The namespace has label `pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted` with audit and warn also set to restricted. Additionally, a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL-based, v1.28 beta feature) is configured with expression `!has(object.spec.containers[*].securityContext.privileged) || object.spec.containers[*].securityContext.privileged == false` and a binding targeting the worker namespace. The cluster also runs Kyverno 1.11 with a ClusterPolicy in enforce mode that denies any pod with hostPath volumes or hostPID/hostNetwork. Note: WebSocket connections still lack origin validation at the application layer, and the command injection in _execute_diagnostic remains in the code.
